script.es: Familia, precio justo, trabajo bien hecho.
script.en: Family owned, fair pricing, done right.

parrafo.es: Abba's Tree Service es un equipo familiar que atiende Ocala y Marion County. Isaiah y su equipo (Nathaniel, RJ y Courtney) se encargan de la tala de árboles, poda, retiro de árboles peligrosos y limpieza de escombros, con un presupuesto claro antes de empezar.
parrafo.en: Abba's Tree Service is a family owned crew serving Ocala and Marion County. Isaiah and the team (Nathaniel, RJ and Courtney) handle tree removal, trimming, hazard tree removal and full debris cleanup, with a clear price before any work starts.

hero.imagen_alt: Climber working high in a large oak tree above a bucket truck during a tree removal job by Abba's Tree Service

parrafo_1.es: Abba's Tree Service es un negocio familiar que atiende Ocala y Marion County, desde la tala de árboles grandes hasta la poda, el retiro de árboles peligrosos y la limpieza completa del terreno.
parrafo_1.en: Abba's Tree Service is a family owned business serving Ocala and Marion County, from large tree removal to trimming, hazard tree removal and full site cleanup.

parrafo_2.es: Los clientes repiten lo mismo en sus reseñas de Google: precio justo, trabajo profesional y limpieza completa de escombros al terminar. Una clienta cuenta que llevan 4 años trabajando con ellos y ya han retirado 8 árboles grandes de su propiedad, incluyendo un pino muerto que representaba un peligro para las casas y vecinos.
parrafo_2.en: Clients keep saying the same thing in their Google reviews: fair pricing, professional work and a full debris cleanup when they are done. One client says she has used them for 4 years and they have taken out 8 large trees on her property, including a dead pine tree that was a threat to houses and neighbors.

texto.es: Cuéntanos qué necesitas: tala, poda, un árbol peligroso o limpieza tras una tormenta.
texto.en: Tell us what you need: removal, trimming, a hazard tree or storm cleanup.

texto.es: El equipo revisa el árbol y te da un precio claro antes de empezar.
texto.en: The team looks at the tree and gives you a clear price before starting.

texto.es: Isaiah y el equipo hacen el trabajo con cuidado, con la insurance en regla.
texto.en: Isaiah and the crew do the work with care, fully insured.

texto.es: Se llevan todos los escombros. Tu propiedad queda limpia, tal como cuentan sus clientes.
texto.en: They haul away all the debris. Your property is left clean, exactly as their clients describe it.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza según el árbol y el alcance. Llama y te damos un presupuesto gratis sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every job is quoted based on the tree and the scope of work. Call for a free estimate, no obligation.

texto.es: Retiro completo de árboles grandes, incluso varios en una misma propiedad, como cuentan los clientes que llevan años trabajando con ellos.
texto.en: Full removal of large trees, including multiple trees on the same property, as described by clients who have worked with them for years.

texto.es: Poda de árboles con un precio justo, incluso cuando se coordina con varios vecinos a la vez.
texto.en: Tree trimming at a fair price, even when it is coordinated with several neighbors at once.

texto.es: Retiro de árboles muertos o dañados que amenazan casas, autos o vecinos, como el pino que quitaron recientemente para una clienta.
texto.en: Removal of dead or damaged trees that threaten houses, cars or neighbors, like the dead pine they recently took down for a client.

texto.es: El equipo limpia todos los escombros al terminar el trabajo, sin dejar nada en tu propiedad.
texto.en: The crew cleans up all the debris when the job is done, leaving nothing behind on your property.

pie.es: ¿No ves tu proyecto en la lista? Llama igual, seguro lo cubrimos.
pie.en: Do not see your project listed? Call anyway, we likely cover it.

I highly recommend this family company, we have been using Abba Tree Service for the past 4 years. They have taken out 8 large trees, most recently this week a very tall pine tree that was dead a threat to cars, houses and neighbors.
I just had my trees trimmed yesterday. The crew did a great job and cleaned up all the debris. The price they quoted me and my 2 neighbors was very fair. Great - Quality work. Was a good experience.
